titles.romaji: San Ti Duan Pian Ji: Ping Xing Zhi Jing
titles.native: 三体短篇集: 平行之境

description:
Based on the vast sci-fi universe of Cixin Liu’s original work, San Ti Duan Pian Ji: Ping Xing Zhi Jing presents six standalone animated shorts, each with its own distinct style. Expanding new narratives from the original's philosophical allegories, historical gaps, and future extrapolations, the anthology focuses on the choices of human nature in extreme environments while pioneering diverse visual expressions of Chinese sci-fi. Whether questioning the courage to rebuild faith in science or exploring the path forward for civilization through the eyes of ordinary people in a monumental era, these stories further push the boundaries of original Chinese sci-fi.

(Source: BiliBili, translated)
